title.zh: 赛事计时与成绩协调员

vacancy_label: Wholly fictional synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Prepare bib-chip mappings and test timing readers before an event.
requirements.zh: 在活动前准备号码布与芯片对应关系，并测试计时芯片读取器。

requirements.en: Reconcile anomalous reads with backup evidence while distinguishing detection counts from participant counts.
requirements.zh: 依据备用证据核对异常读取，并区分检测记录数与参赛人数。

requirements.en: Communicate provisional results and follow the event's correction and official-classification approval process.
requirements.zh: 沟通暂定成绩，并遵循赛事更正及正式排名审批流程。

requirements.en: Recruit, roster and formally supervise seasonal timing staff.
requirements.zh: 招聘、排班并正式管理季节性计时人员。

requirements.en: Preferred: hold course-measurement certification and sign certified race-distance reports.
requirements.zh: 优先：持有赛道测量认证，并签署认证比赛距离报告。
